entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's Tsuboi's Shadow. No doubt about it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Shadow spotted. It's Tsuboi's, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He seems a little irritated.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I heard he was abusin' animals just to take[n]his anger out on them.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't let him get away with something like[n]that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys, don't go easy on him!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Cats? What about cats?

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Maybe they die when I use 'em to blow off[n]steam, but the shelter was gonna kill 'em,[n]anyway.

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: In fact, I bet those cats are happy to be so[n]useful to humans!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What a poor excuse for a human being![n]I could never forgive someone like you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Why don't you complain to the irresponsible[n]people taking their pets to the pound, huh?

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Well, who cares. You guys are superheroes,[n]right? Then hurry up and destroy this rotten[n]society!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll take your twisted desires, but first I'll[n]show you the pain you caused those poor[n]animals!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Huh? Wait, are you some kind of cat[n]monster?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's do it, Joker! I'll show you the wrath of[n]cats!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Owww, it hurts! You're gonna kill me...
Feel the pain...
Did we overdo it?
We're putting you in a cage.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those cats were actually gettin' killed 'cause[n]of you. Don't you get it now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who cares? He's a scumbag.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's a good idea. Perhaps then, he'll[n]understand what those animals had to[n]endure.

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: I-I'm sorry! Wh-What should I do?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Remember the awful things you did to those[n]cats. Doesn't it make you feel horrible?

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: *sob* I've done something terrible. I'm even[n]less than an animal. I'm worthless trash...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I won't tell you to give up your life. But you[n]will spend the rest of your life in guilt.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aww yeah, there it is! The Treasure!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsuboi
entries.en: Me-Meeooooowwww!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Never do that again! You better fully atone[n]for the crimes you committed!
